scope: Actual visual review of all twenty-one assigned immutable images, complete final LuaLaTeX log, complete final BibTeX log, and four-stage final build transcript. This is a layout/build review, not a new mathematical proof audit.

overall_visual_observations: All twenty-one assigned images were actually opened and emitted. No clipped text, overlapping equations or tags, missing glyphs, misplaced footers, or broken tables were found. Prior bibliography accent and spacing repairs remain clear.
